about: v0.5b Kathā story lines (OWNER: WP-D): the new lines inside { "if": "style.katha", "then": [...] } blocks of chapter 6 that were not already in sa-dialogue-5.json at v0.5a, and the new Kathā-only speaker titles there ("label": true). Same format and rules as files 1–5 (notes/sambhashana.md); en and ctx are generated by collectStoryStrings() (file 9), fill sa only.

entries.en: He has come from our enemy. Let Rama test him first.
entries.sa: सः अस्माकं शत्रोः पक्षात् आगतवान्। प्रथमं रामः तं परीक्षताम्।
entries.ctx: ch6.angada_shore · person.angada (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.17: Aṅgada's counsel — one who comes from the enemy must be tested first

entries.en: Return to Vibhishana and hear what Rama decides.
entries.sa: विभीषणं प्रति गच्छतु। रामस्य वचनं शृणोतु।

entries.en: Vibhishana waits. First ask Angada for his counsel.
entries.sa: विभीषणः प्रतीक्षते। प्रथमम् अङ्गदस्य मतं पृच्छ।

entries.en: Rama turns to his counsellors: "What do you say?"
entries.sa: रामः मन्त्रिणः पृच्छति, 'भवन्तः किं वदन्ति?'

entries.en: Ask Angada for his counsel.
entries.sa: अङ्गदस्य मतं पृच्छतु।

entries.en: Go, bring him to me. Say my vow to him.
entries.sa: गच्छ, तम् अत्र आनय। मम व्रतं तस्मै वद।
entries.ctx: ch6.vibhishana_refuge · person.rama (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.18.34: आनयैनं … दत्तमस्याभयं मया (Rāma: bring him; I have given him fearlessness)

entries.en: Vibhishana hears the vow and comes down from the sky.
entries.sa: विभीषणः व्रतं श्रुत्वा आकाशात् अवतरति।

entries.en: Let every stone sit true. Then the bridge will reach Lanka.
entries.sa: सर्वाः शिलाः सम्यक् तिष्ठन्तु। तदा सेतुः लङ्कां प्राप्स्यति।

entries.en: Fourteen yojanas on the first day; then twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two and twenty-three. A hundred yojanas in all.
entries.sa: प्रथमे दिने १४ योजनानि। ततः २०, २१, २२, २३ च। एवं सेतुः शतं योजनानि दीर्घः।
entries.ctx: ch6.nala · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.22.66–70 (14, 20, 21, 22, 23 yojanas a day), 6.22.74 (a hundred long); valmikiramayan.net

entries.en: From the Pushpaka, Rama shows Sita the places of their story.
entries.sa: पुष्पकात् रामः सीतायै कथायाः स्थानानि दर्शयति।
entries.ctx: ch6.ravana · narration (Kathā) — Yuddha 6.123 (Rāma shows Sītā Laṅkā, the setu, Kiṣkindhā, Ṛśyamūka, Pampā, Janasthāna, Pañcavaṭī … Ayodhyā)

entries.en: Rama asks you: "Where did we hear this verse?"
entries.sa: रामः त्वां पृच्छति, 'एतं श्लोकं वयं कुत्र श्रुतवन्तः?'

entries.en: In Kishkindha.
entries.sa: किष्किन्धायाम्।

entries.en: In Lanka.
entries.sa: लङ्कायाम्।

entries.en: In Ayodhya.
entries.sa: अयोध्यायाम्।

entries.en: Not there. Look down again.
entries.sa: तत्र न। पुनः अधः पश्य।

entries.en: On the ocean shore.
entries.sa: समुद्रस्य तीरे।

entries.en: By Lake Pampa.
entries.sa: पम्पायाः तीरे।

entries.en: On Chitrakuta.
entries.sa: चित्रकूटे।

entries.en: At Panchavati.
entries.sa: पञ्चवट्याम्।

entries.en: On Rishyamuka hill.
entries.sa: ऋश्यमूके।

entries.en: Kusha and Lava, two boys of this ashrama, have learned my whole story.
entries.sa: कुशः लवः च अस्य आश्रमस्य बालकौ। तौ मम सर्वां कथां पठितवन्तौ।

entries.en: Go with them to Ayodhya, and sing it before Rama.
entries.sa: ताभ्यां सह अयोध्यां गच्छ। रामस्य पुरतः तां गाय।

entries.en: The twins sing in the streets of Ayodhya. Rama hears them and brings them into his palace.
entries.sa: कुशः लवः च अयोध्यायाः मार्गेषु गायतः। रामः तौ श्रुत्वा प्रासादं नयति।

entries.en: Rama sits on his throne. His brothers and ministers are with him.
entries.sa: रामः आसने उपविशति। तेन सह भ्रातरः मन्त्रिणः च सन्ति।

entries.en: Brothers, listen. These two sing a great story.
entries.sa: हे भ्रातरः, शृणुत। एतौ महतीं कथां गायतः।
entries.ctx: ch6.epilogue_valmiki · person.rama (Kathā) — Bāla 1.4.32–35 (Rāma to Lakṣmaṇa, Śatrughna and Bharata)

entries.en: {player}, sing with them: say one line in every book.
entries.sa: {player}, ताभ्यां सह गाय। सर्वेषु काण्डेषु एकं पादं पठ।

entries.en: Kusha and Lava sing.
entries.sa: कुशः लवः च गायतः।

entries.en: Rama listens with his brothers. His whole mind is on the story.
entries.sa: रामः भ्रातृभिः सह शृणोति। तस्य मनः कथायाम् एव अस्ति।

entries.en: As long as there are mountains and rivers, Rama's story will live.
entries.sa: यावत् पर्वताः नद्यः च सन्ति, तावत् रामस्य कथा जीविष्यति।
entries.ctx: ch6.epilogue_valmiki · person.valmiki (Kathā) — Bāla 2.36–37 (Brahmā's blessing to Vālmīki: यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयः सरितश्च महीतले …), recalled by Vālmīki
